PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>

PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>

PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>

CONSTRUCT {
    _:bnode rdfs:label ?year .
}
WHERE {
    SELECT ?year (COUNT(?publication) AS ?paperCount)
    WHERE {
        ?publication dblp:authoredBy <https://dblp.org/pid/224/5236> .
        ?publication dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
    }
    GROUP BY ?year
    ORDER BY DESC(?paperCount)

PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>

CONSTRUCT {
    <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/3pgcic/SandlerT12> dblp:authoredBy ?author .
    ?author dblp:creatorName ?authorName .
    ?otherPublication dblp:authoredBy ?author .
    ?otherPublication dblp:publishedIn ?venue .
}
WHERE {
    BIND(<https://dblp.org/rec/conf/3pgcic/SandlerT12> AS ?initialPublication) .

    ?initialPublication dblp:authoredBy ?author .
    ?author dblp:creatorName ?authorName .

    ?otherPublication dblp:authoredBy ?author .
    FILTER (?otherPublication != ?initialPublication) .

    ?otherPublication dblp:publishedIn ?venue .
}

question: Have the authors of the paper 'Real-time volt/var optimization for distribution systems with photovoltaic integration' not published a publication in IECON?
construct_query:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX cito: <http://purl.org/spar/cito/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/>

CONSTRUCT {
  <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/iecon/ChenLWDB17> dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  ?author rdf:type dblp:Creator .
  ?author dblp:creatorName ?authorName .
}
WHERE {
  # Get all authors of the target paper
  <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/iecon/ChenLWDB17> dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  ?author rdf:type dblp:Creator .
  OPTIONAL { ?author dblp:creatorName ?authorName . }

  # This FILTER NOT EXISTS checks if ANY author of the initial paper has published in IECON.
  # If such an author exists, the subquery will return results, making the FILTER NOT EXISTS condition false.
  # In this case, the entire WHERE clause will yield no results, and the CONSTRUCT will be empty.
  # This implies: "No, they HAVE published in IECON."
  #
  # If NO such author exists (meaning ALL authors of the initial paper have NOT published in IECON),
  # the subquery will return no results, making the FILTER NOT EXISTS condition true.
  # In this case, the authors of the initial paper will be constructed.
  # This implies: "Yes, they have NOT published in IECON."
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    SELECT ?anyAuthorOfTargetPaper
    WHERE {
      <https://dblp.org/rec/conf/iecon/ChenLWDB17> dblp:authoredBy ?anyAuthorOfTargetPaper .
      ?anyAuthorOfTargetPaper dblp:authorOf ?publicationInIECON .
      ?publicationInIECON dblp:publishedIn "IECON" .
    }
  }
}

CONSTRUCT {
  ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  ?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
}

  # Get the authors of the specified paper
  <https://dblp.org/rec/journals/dt/VillacortaHCSG13> dblp:authoredBy ?initialPaperAuthor .

  # Find all papers authored by these authors
  ?paper dblp:authoredBy ?author .
  FILTER (?author = ?initialPaperAuthor) .

  ?paper dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
  FILTER (?year = "2013"^^xsd:gYear) .
}
